Theorem
[Perelman stability] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0432 ↗ thm:chow-iii-g43-g44-compactness 1. appG:G.57\group Aleksandrov structure

For a compact $n$-dimensional Aleksandrov space $X$ of curvature $\geq k$, a sufficiently close compact $n$-dimensional Aleksandrov space $Y$ of the same lower curvature bound is homeomorphic to $X$.
